market_pricing_in:
Mr. Market is pricing in the structural exhaustion of PepsiCo's multi-year era of frictionless pricing power and direct-store-delivery (DSD) volume leverage at $133.66 per share (20.4x P/OE, 25.2x EV/OE). After compounding cumulative price increases exceeding 30% between 2022 and 2024, the franchise hit an acute consumer elasticity wall across its flagship, highest-margin engine, Frito-Lay North America (PFNA). Wall Street remains skeptical of management's turnaround execution, noting that aggressive price rollbacks of up to 15% across key snack lines and a 20% domestic SKU rationalization have delivered flat volume response while diluting segment margins.

Furthermore, institutional bears see secular impairment rather than routine cyclical softness. A heavily levered balance sheet with $53.2B in debt ($-31.34 net cash per share), persistent channel foot-traffic declines in high-margin convenience and gas stations, and accelerating health headwinds from GLP-1 adoption and ultra-processed food scrutiny have caused the market to re-rate PepsiCo as a mature, capital-intensive packaged goods operator facing terminal multiple compression rather than an elite compounder.

2. Forensic Business Headwinds: If consumer resistance to branded savory snacks hardens into permanent value-seeking behavior, private-label alternatives continue capturing share, and high-margin impulse purchases in the convenience channel stay depressed. Concurrently, widespread GLP-1 adoption curtails per-capita snacking occasions, forcing margin-dilutive product reformulations and elevated promotional allowances.

3. Skeptic Unit Contraction: Total convenient food and beverage volume units contract by 2.0% annually across the direct-store-delivery and warehouse networks, while net price realization falls by 1.0% per year due to continuous defensive discounting. Consolidated net revenue contracts from the current $96,724.0M run-rate to $88,250.0M by Year 3.

4. Normalized Owner Earnings degrade to $4.80 per share ($6,571.0M total).
